panel.non_representation_statement: Owner-executed simulated-community challenge; no actual community participation, representation, consultation, endorsement, consent or independent review.

Statistical software agreement is bounded algorithmic evidence, not clinical validity.
cannot_infer: Completed NCHS reliability assessment or joint statistical-output release approval
Hosted CI, merge or tagged release

uncertainty: Python/OS prerequisites remain required; this is same-host macOS arm64 CPython3.13 evidence, not bare-machine or cross-platform qualification.
Result hashes are not signatures and do not defend against privileged replacement.
Self-report, proxy-response, nonresponse and diagnostic-access bias remain; no age standardization.
dissent: Public substantive population-estimate release is not recommended until reliability and joint disclosure disposition are complete.
stop_triggers: Input hashes or source terms differ.
Required tests, receipt integrity or algorithmic agreement fail.
Scope expands to controlled data, clinical inference or actual community/custodian claims.

options.title: Accept experimental real-public-data toolkit
trade_offs: Closes bounded real-data implementation acceptance without claiming production or substantive population release.
contingencies: Keep real statistical findings local pending reliability and joint disclosure assessment; any package release remains separately exact-bound.
options.rationale: The real-data runner, offline installation, recovery and fixed-estimator algorithmic agreement are evidenced; unsupported claims remain excluded.
minimum_evidence: This exact commit/tree and evidence manifest, passing validations and final installed-wheel receipt.

options.title: Defer candidate acceptance
trade_offs: Retains all work and evidence but leaves real-data acceptance unresolved.
contingencies: Reopen on requested method, platform or scope changes with renewed evidence.
options.rationale: Appropriate if the bounded experimental scope does not meet the owner's intended release objective.
minimum_evidence: Retain the current candidate and its evidence without representing it as accepted.

recommendation.rationale: Accept demonstrated repository-owned real-data capabilities now while retaining explicit statistical-publication and deployment boundaries.

owner_decision.rationale: The owner explicitly replied 'I approve option A.' to the exact-candidate question for 97380ef. This records acceptance of the experimental real-public-data toolkit under Option A's stated limits, not statistical publication, package release, production deployment or clinical validity. The UTC time records receipt of the approval; candidate and evidence bindings remain unchanged.
